item.title: Self-Hosted Config Symlink Management: GNU Stow vs vcsh vs etckeeper
item.description: Managing configuration files across multiple machines is a perennial challenge for developers and system administrators. Your .bashrc, .vimrc, .gitconfig, and dozens of other dotfiles define your working environment — but keeping them synchronized and version-controlled without creating a tangled mess of symlinks requires discipline and the right tools.
